item.title: When Risk Becomes Personal: What Security Leaders Can Learn From a Cancer Diagnosis
item.dc:creator: Steve Durbin
item.description:
Risk managers are trained to spot weak signals, plan for disruption and make hard decisions under uncertainty. But the discipline looks different when the risk is not a system or an enterprise, but you.

The post When Risk Becomes Personal: What Security Leaders Can Learn From a Cancer Diagnosis appeared first on SecurityWeek.
